senses.gloss: m.(b. h. שְׂאֹר; שאר to swell, rise)
rise, swelling Maasr. I, 2 התמרים משיטילו ש׳ (Ar. dates are subject to tithes when they begin to swell (rise like dough), expl. Y. ib. 48ᵈ bot. משיתמלא החרץ, v. חֶרֶץ; Y. Dem. I, 21ᶜ bot.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 2:6">Ḥall. II, 6</cite> <he>הם ושְׂאוֹרָן וכ׳</he> if they (the quantities of flour) with the leaven put in and the bran … make up the five Kabs.
<cite ref="Pesachim 5a:20">Pes. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>השבתת ש׳</he> the removal of leaven (<cite ref="Exodus 21:15">Ex. XXI, 15</cite>).
Bets. 7ᵇ ש׳ שאין ראוי וכ׳ leaven, which is not fit to eat, opp. חמץ; a. fr.—Trnsf. passion, evil inclination, corruption.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:10">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 8:21">Gen. VIII, 21</cite>) <he>עלוב הוא הש׳ וכ׳</he> it is poor leaven which he that created it declares to be bad.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 601:4">Yalk. Ruth 601</cite> <he>אל תאמן … תופס שְׂאוֹרוֹ</he> trust no proselyte up to twenty-four generations, for he still retains his corruption, v. <cite ref="O00518"><he>סִיאוּר</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="U00776"><he>שִׂיאוּר</he></cite>.
